newsitem.title: USA: Matsushita names Panasonic unit chief.
newsitem.headline: Matsushita names Panasonic unit chief.

text.p: Matsushita Electric Corp of America said on Friday has appointed Koshi "Kurt" Kitadai president and chief operating officer of its Panasonic Industrial Co division, effective Oct. 1.
Kitadai, who succeeds Toshi Horiuchi, will direct Panasonic Industrial's sales and marketing efforts to the North American manufacturing sector, Matsushita said.
Kitadai was named director of the Shizuoka Industrial Sales office of Matsushita Electric Industrial Co Ltd, Panasonic's parent company, in late 1993, Matsushita said.
